usedFor: BlueyEmail collects form answers and Sangam CRM tracks the sales, so “When a form is submitted” can open an opportunity with “Create Opportunity”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a form is submitted” in BlueyEmail, then “Create Opportunity” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A submitted form is a lead raising a hand, and the action can record it with a next follow-up date.

watchOut: “When a contact unsubscribes” also triggers “Create Opportunity”, so choose the form event if you only want interested leads.
